{{Top}}
'''Red Nine''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the ninth member of [[Red Squadron]]. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] squadrons with this name, and as a result a number of pilots flew under the call sign.

The call sign was used by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] Lieutenant [[Nozzo Naytaan/Legends|Naytaan]] during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Naytaan was killed in the assault against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]].
